title: Bleed Isolation Valve Actuator — Installation

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the bleed isolation valve actuator and its position regulator, with the rigging procedure and the travel test that must be completed before the fan cowl is closed.

sections.purpose: To install the isolation valve actuator and its matched position regulator and to prove the installation with a valve travel test at ambient temperature.
sections.job_setup_note: The fan cowl must be open and supported and the aircraft de-powered for the mechanical work. External power and a pneumatic source are needed for the travel test. Two persons are needed. The rigging value recorded at removal must be available before the task is started.
sections.procedure: Make sure that the electrical power is removed and that the warning notices are in position. Clean the actuator flange face on the valve body D3610116310629 and examine the drive spline for wear. Apply a thin film of anti-seize compound to the spline. Install the position regulator D3610120750241 on its bracket and connect the sensing line. Torque the sensing line union to 12 Nm. CAUTION: DO NOT OVERTIGHTEN THE SENSING LINE UNION. THE FITTING IS THIN WALLED AND WILL DISTORT. Put the actuator on the drive spline squarely and turn it by hand until it engages. Install the four flange bolts and torque them to 22 Nm in a diagonal sequence. Set the actuator to the rigging value recorded at removal using the rigging pin set. Install the cushioned clamps EN984959K3 at the duct joint and fit new swaged collars EN767708K2. Connect the actuator and regulator harnesses and make sure that each connector is fully engaged and locked. Restore the electrical power and connect the pneumatic source. WARNING: KEEP CLEAR OF THE VALVE LINKAGE DURING THE TRAVEL TEST. THE ACTUATOR MOVES WITHOUT WARNING. Do the valve travel test three times and record the travel time for each direction. Make sure that the recorded times are inside the band in the acceptance table.
sections.close_out: Disconnect the pneumatic source and remove the electrical power. Make sure that no tools or loose hardware remain in the pylon. Remove the hold-open rod and close the fan cowl. Remove the warning notices and the safety barriers. Record the installation, the serial numbers, the rigging value and the three travel times.

safety_precautions: Keep clear of the valve linkage during the travel test.
Put the safety barriers in position.
Support the fan cowl on the hold-open rod.
